targets.rawSql: SELECT name as "Repository" FROM repositories WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT COUNT(*) as "Total Commits" FROM commits WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT COUNT(*) as "Total PRs" FROM pull_requests WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) as "Contributors" FROM commits WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) as "Active Contributors"
FROM commits
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

SELECT COALESCE(test_coverage, 0) as "Test Coverage"
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(v.id) as "Vulnerabilities"
FROM vulnerabilities v
JOIN dependencies d ON v.dependency_id = d.id
WHERE d.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND d.analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) as "Open PRs"
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND status = 'open';

SELECT COUNT(*) as "Stale Branches"
FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT branch_id, staleness_days, timestamp,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY branch_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC) as rn
  FROM branch_metrics
) bm ON b.branch_id = bm.branch_id AND bm.rn = 1
WHERE b.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND b.is_active = true
  AND COALESCE(bm.staleness_days, 999) > 30;

SELECT COALESCE(technical_debt_minutes / 60, 0)::int as "Tech Debt"
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', commit_date) as time,
  COUNT(*) as commits
FROM commits
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', commit_date)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', commit_date) as time,
  SUM(lines_added) as added,
  SUM(lines_removed) as removed
FROM commits
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', commit_date)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(c.name, c.email) as contributor,
  COUNT(cm.commit_sha) as commits
FROM contributors c
JOIN commits cm ON c.id = cm.author_id
WHERE cm.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND cm.commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email
ORDER BY commits DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(c.name, c.email) as reviewer,
  COUNT(r.id) as reviews
FROM contributors c
JOIN pr_reviews r ON c.id = r.reviewer_id
JOIN pull_requests pr ON r.pr_id = pr.id
WHERE pr.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND r.review_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email
ORDER BY reviews DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
GROUP BY status;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(size_category, 'unknown') as size_category, 
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY size_category;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', created_at) as time,
  COUNT(*) as created
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', merged_at) as time,
  COUNT(*) as merged
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND merged_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', merged_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (merged_at - created_at)) / 86400),
    0
  )::numeric(10,1) as "Days to Merge"
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND merged_at IS NOT NULL
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days';

SELECT COUNT(*) as "PRs with Issues"
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND has_issues = true
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

SELECT 
  COALESCE(AVG(comment_count), 0)::numeric(10,1) as "Avg Comments"
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

SELECT 
  COALESCE(AVG(approval_count), 0)::numeric(10,1) as "Avg Approvals"
FROM pull_requests
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

SELECT 
  timestamp as time,
  critical_issues as critical,
  high_issues as high,
  medium_issues as medium,
  low_issues as low
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT 
  timestamp as time,
  test_coverage as coverage
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT 
  timestamp as time,
  technical_debt_minutes as debt
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT 
  'Critical' as severity, COALESCE(critical_issues, 0) as count
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'High', COALESCE(high_issues, 0)
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Medium', COALESCE(medium_issues, 0)
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Low', COALESCE(low_issues, 0)
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COALESCE(maintainability_index, 0) as "Maintainability"
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COALESCE(complexity_score, 0) as "Complexity"
FROM code_quality_metrics
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  v.severity,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM vulnerabilities v
JOIN dependencies d ON v.dependency_id = d.id
WHERE d.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND d.analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  )
GROUP BY v.severity
ORDER BY 
  CASE v.severity 
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 
  END;

SELECT COUNT(*) as "Outdated"
FROM dependencies
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND version != latest_version
  AND latest_version IS NOT NULL
  AND analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) as "End of Life"
FROM dependencies
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND is_eol = true
  AND analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  );

SELECT 
  ecosystem,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM dependencies
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  )
GROUP BY ecosystem;

SELECT COUNT(*) as "Dev Dependencies"
FROM dependencies
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND is_dev_dependency = true
  AND analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  );

SELECT 
  d.package_name as "Package",
  d.version as "Version",
  v.cve_id as "CVE",
  v.severity as "Severity",
  LEFT(v.summary, 100) as "Summary",
  v.fixed_in_version as "Fixed In",
  v.published_date as "Published"
FROM vulnerabilities v
JOIN dependencies d ON v.dependency_id = d.id
WHERE d.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND d.analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  )
ORDER BY 
  CASE v.severity 
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 
  END,
  v.published_date DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) as "Active Branches"
FROM branches
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND is_active = true;

SELECT 
  b.branch_name,
  COALESCE(bm.staleness_days, 0) as "Days Inactive"
FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT branch_id, staleness_days,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY branch_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC) as rn
  FROM branch_metrics
) bm ON b.branch_id = bm.branch_id AND bm.rn = 1
WHERE b.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND b.is_active = true
ORDER BY staleness_days DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
  b.branch_name,
  COALESCE(bm.divergence_from_main, 0) as "Commits Diverged"
FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT branch_id, divergence_from_main,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY branch_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC) as rn
  FROM branch_metrics
) bm ON b.branch_id = bm.branch_id AND bm.rn = 1
WHERE b.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND b.is_active = true
  AND b.branch_name != (SELECT default_branch FROM repositories WHERE repo_id = '${repository}')
ORDER BY divergence_from_main DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
  b.branch_name as "Branch",
  COALESCE(bm.commit_count, 0) as "Commits",
  COALESCE(bm.unique_contributors, 0) as "Contributors",
  COALESCE(bm.age_days, 0) as "Age (Days)",
  COALESCE(bm.staleness_days, 0) as "Days Inactive",
  COALESCE(bm.divergence_from_main, 0) as "Divergence",
  LEFT(b.latest_commit_sha, 7) as "Latest Commit"
FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT branch_id, commit_count, unique_contributors, age_days, staleness_days, divergence_from_main,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY branch_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC) as rn
  FROM branch_metrics
) bm ON b.branch_id = bm.branch_id AND bm.rn = 1
WHERE b.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND b.is_active = true
ORDER BY staleness_days ASC;

SELECT 
  language,
  percentage
FROM repository_languages
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM repository_languages WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  )
ORDER BY percentage DESC;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(summary_text, 'No summary available') as "Summary",
  COALESCE(purpose, '') as "Purpose",
  COALESCE(array_to_string(key_technologies, ', '), '') as "Key Technologies",
  generated_at as "Generated"
FROM repository_summaries
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY generated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  LEFT(commit_sha, 7) as "SHA",
  COALESCE(c.name, c.email) as "Author",
  LEFT(cm.message, 80) as "Message",
  cm.files_changed as "Files",
  cm.lines_added as "+Lines",
  cm.lines_removed as "-Lines",
  cm.commit_date as "Date"
FROM commits cm
LEFT JOIN contributors c ON cm.author_id = c.id
WHERE cm.repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY cm.commit_date DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
  pr.pr_number as "PR #",
  pr.title as "Title",
  COALESCE(c.name, c.email) as "Author",
  pr.source_branch as "Source",
  pr.target_branch as "Target",
  pr.size_category as "Size",
  pr.files_changed as "Files",
  pr.lines_added as "+Lines",
  pr.lines_removed as "-Lines",
  pr.comment_count as "Comments",
  pr.approval_count as "Approvals",
  pr.has_issues as "Has Issues",
  pr.created_at as "Created"
FROM pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN contributors c ON pr.author_id = c.id
WHERE pr.repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND pr.status = 'open'
ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC;
